payload.goal: Retrieve, analyze, and rank representative NAD(P)HX repair protein sequence candidates for the dehydratase and epimerase activities using available sequence-focused VPA tools.
assumptions: Candidate discovery will start from GO-annotated UniProt sequence retrieval because no seed sequences or FASTA inputs were provided.

nodes.intent: Retrieve representative UniProt sequence candidates annotated to the NAD(P)HX dehydratase molecular function.
Retrieve representative UniProt sequence candidates annotated to the NADPHX epimerase molecular function.
Compute sequence-level biochemical annotations, liabilities, and motif/region summaries across the retrieved repair-protein candidates.
Compute lightweight sequence-only QC metrics to help triage representative repair-protein candidates before ranking.
Generate sequence embeddings for the retrieved repair-protein candidates to support representation-aware comparison during downstream ranking.
Aggregate retrieved candidates and their analysis/QC-derived candidate records into a deterministically ranked representative set.

finalization.ranking_preference: prefer reviewed, deduplicated non-IEA candidates with favorable sequence QC profiles and representative embedding coverage across both repair activities
